concept: Review and integration: boundaries as self-respect, not selfishness or coldness
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across spotting manipulation, setting boundaries with people you care about, and knowing what's firm versus flexible — where do you still struggle?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real relationship where a clearer boundary would help — this connects directly to what they practice live with Grit

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
